text:
tess: Heads-up — deploy-bot paused the promotion. Staging canaries failing: multiple artifact uploads timed out and we also saw checksum mismatches on a subset of chunks.

deploy-bot: Promotion paused (reason: artifact_upload_failures).

logs:
```
uploader: multipart chunk write timeout after 22s
verifier: chunk checksum mismatch (expected=0x1a2b3c got=0x9f8e7d) x4
registry: 503 slow_down x 18
cache-shard: queue_depth=420, evictions rising
```

max: Seen both timeout + checksum together before when upload retries interleave and partial chunks hit different mirrors. Quick mitigations: 1) reduce multipart concurrency, 2) route to eu-west mirror, or 3) pin to the last-known-good image and rerun.

release-coordinator: Change window in ~30m. Recommend manual pin to avoid a risky live rollback during the window. Document pin in release notes and include why.

tess: I'll open a promo-pin and queue a rerun with concurrency=2. Pin PR: https://deploybot/internal/pins/3129999999 — pinned to sha256:ddb3a4f1. Note: "manual pin due to multipart timeouts and intermittent checksum flaps".

ci-bot: Rerun scheduled on pinned image: pipeline #6017 (queued).

infra-oncall: Investigating shard behavior. Observing tail write latencies and sporadic read-after-write inconsistency across mirror replicas. Temporarily scaling the mirror group and increasing upload buffer. Collecting verifier traces and mirror sync logs. ETA ~10m.

max: Adding checklist to ticket: uploader chunk traces, verifier mismatch counts, mirror sync lag, registry 503 counts, deploy-bot backpressure metrics.

release-coordinator: I'll update release notes: "Cut held — pinned to last-good image due to artifact upload timeouts and checksum flaps; infra investigating mirror sync and shard tail latency." Marking promo as "held - pinned" on tracker.

tess: If infra stabilizes inside the window we can unpin and promote; otherwise we keep the pin and move the cut to the next change window. Posting updates to #release-updates.
